digest.component_or_area: contribution flow documentation and code-review guidance
propositions: Gerrit changes with known unresolved issues must be marked as Work In Progress to prevent unintended submission when both review votes are positive
The contribution flow lacks enforceable hold mechanism — hold records in tickets and session logs are invisible to submitters and unenforceable against the standing submit rule
Documentation must specify both WIP spellings (push-time %wip form and POST /a/changes/<n>/wip REST toggle) and unmark paths across all three surfaces authors and agents read
The packaged code-review guide must surface the WIP hold rule through the registry mapping so rebar explain review carries it without requiring CONTRIBUTING.md lookup
Test coverage must assert the rule is present and reachable through packaged surfaces, not just file paths, and must fail when the rule is deleted
